responsibility: This file implements textual dumping and debugging support for GCC’s internal HSA IL. It translates BRIG types, opcodes, segments, memory orders, symbols, operands, instructions, and basic blocks into readable assembly-like text, emits per-function dumps including private/global symbols and CFG fallthrough information, and provides debug_* entry points for use from the debugger or dump files. Its responsibility is human-readable inspection of the HSA intermediate representation, distinct from BRIG binary serialization or GIMPLE-to-HSA lowering.
